result: For a three-complex-parameter family of 4x4 local compressions of the explicit 4x5 PPT/SN3 grid state R, a 3x3 Hermitian PSD condition yields an exact SR<=2 decomposition. An independent explicit inequality proves the compressed state entangled, hence SN=2, on a substantial subregion. This includes kernel vectors supported on FOUR computational coordinates and is not limited to the previously solved two-coordinate kernel lines.
source_state: Define [q]=|q><q| and A=|00>+|11>+|22>, B=|01>+|12>, D=|10>-|21>, C=|02>+|34>, E=|20>+|33>, F=|23>, G=|30>, I=|32>, H0=|04>; let R=[A]+[B]+[D]+3([C]+[E]+[F]+[G]+[I]+[H0]). The exact PPT/SN3 certificate and corrected source identity are in frontier-20261028-grid-state-five-projections-v1.json SHA256 9863760e2ca2331164d12e62300f3ad7db5b6a17a3ef424e360d504d541004a9. The published range is Krebs–Gachechiladze, https://arxiv.org/html/2509.07086v1, Eq.11; no source-priority/novelty claim.
projection: Let v=(v0,v1,v2) be arbitrary in C^3. Set K|0>=|0>, K|1>=|1>, K|2>=|2>, K|3>=v0|0>+v1|1>+v2|2>, K|4>=|3>. Thus ker(K)=span{|3>-v0|0>-v1|1>-v2|2>}; K has rank4. Write primes for images of the nine basis vectors, and let R_v=(I tensor K)R(I tensor K)^*.
rank2_phase_seed: Define X=E'-v0 G'-v2 I'=|20>+v1|31>. For every fifth root z, set q_z=z A'+B'-z^2 D'-z^3 X-z^4 v1 G'. Its coefficient rows are [z,1,0,0], [-z^2,z,1,0], [-z^3,z^2,z,0], [-z^4 v1,-z^3 v1,0,0]. Row2=z*row1 and row3=-z^3*v1*row0, so SR(q_z)=2 over C. Because exponents 0,1,2,3,4 are distinct modulo5, (1/5)sum_(z^5=1)[q_z]=[A']+[B']+[D']+[X]+|v1|^2[G'].
residual_gram: Let t=(1,-v0,-v2)^T and H=diag(3,3-|v1|^2,3)-t t^*. In the basis (E',G',I'), this Hermitian matrix represents 3([E']+[G']+[I'])-[X]-|v1|^2[G']. Thus R_v=(1/5)sum_z[q_z]+3([C']+[F']+[H0'])+sum_(j,k) H_jk |B_j><B_k|, where (B1,B2,B3)=(E',G',I'). Any linear combination of E',G',I' occupies only Alice rows2 and3 and therefore has SR<=2. Whenever H>=0, spectral/Cholesky factorization of H turns the last term into a nonnegative sum of SR<=2 projectors, proving SN(R_v)<=2.
explicit_psd_domain: Write d=3-|v1|^2. If d>0, H>=0 is equivalent by the rank-one Schur complement to (1+|v2|^2)/3 + |v0|^2/d <=1. If d=0, H>=0 exactly when v0=0 and 1+|v2|^2<=3. If d<0, H is not PSD. This is a sufficient certificate for SN<=2, not a necessity for SN<=2 outside the PSD domain.
actual_ppt: R_v>=0 by construction and R_v^Gamma=(I tensor conjugate(K))R^Gamma(I tensor conjugate(K))^*>=0 by the explicit source PPT decomposition. Its trace is 25+6(|v0|^2+|v1|^2+|v2|^2)>0, so the normalized R_v is a physical 4x4 PPT state.
entanglement_subregion: Project Alice and Bob to labels0,1,2. The core is T_v=[A]+[B]+[D]+3([02]+[20]+[|2> tensor v]). If (v1,v2)!=(0,0), its actual range has unique coordinates M=[[a,b,c],[d,a,b],[e+v0*f,-d+v1*f,a+v2*f]]. A rank-one vector satisfies a^2-bd=0 and a^2+bd+(a*v2-b*v1)f=0, hence 2a^2=-(a*v2-b*v1)f. For any hypothetical separable decomposition, positivity puts each product vector in that range; Cauchy-Schwarz gives 2 sum|a|^2<=sqrt((sum|a*v2-b*v1|^2)(sum|f|^2)). The actual T_v has moments sum|a|^2=1, sum|f|^2=3, and sum|a*v2-b*v1|^2=|v1|^2+|v2|^2 because A and B have zero coefficient covariance. Thus separability would require 4<=3(|v1|^2+|v2|^2). If v1=v2=0 the extra term is just a product multiple of |20>, and the original range argument directly proves entanglement. Consequently H>=0 and 3(|v1|^2+|v2|^2)<4 imply the actual normalized PPT state has SN exactly 2.
explicit_four_support_case: At v0=v1=v2=1/2, ker(K)=span{|3>-(|0>+|1>+|2>)/2} has support4; H has positive rational Schur pivots (2,19/8,195/76), and 3(|v1|^2+|v2|^2)=3/2<4. The normalized state is rho=(2/59)R_v. An independent exact Fraction check gave trace 59/2, rank(R_v)=9, rank(R_v^Gamma)=10, and positive PT Schur pivots [1,1,3,3,2/3,1,3/4,1,3/4,3]. Thus this is an actual 4x4 PPT entangled SN2 state, not merely a relaxed coefficient profile.

verification.observed: Six exact Gaussian-rational choices of v were checked. Each passed all sixteen 3x3 determinant polynomials for q_z identically in formal z and all 256 projected state entries with zero mismatches. Five examples had exact nonnegative Gaussian-rational H Schur pivots, including v=(1/2,1/2,1/2) and a genuinely complex v0=i/2; v=(2,0,0) correctly produced H not PSD while still satisfying the algebraic identity. The latter is NOT a counterexample to SN<=2; only this certificate fails there.
verification.extra_exact_check: The explicit four-support case's state and PPT ranks/pivots were computed separately with Fraction in the evaluator, using the source checker and direct K R K^* construction. No floating arithmetic or external model was used.

limits: This is a proper three-complex-parameter projection chart and an explicit PSD subdomain, not every kernel line or every PPT state. The entanglement inequality is sufficient, not necessary. General kernel lines having a nonzero |4> component as well as mixed head components, and parameters outside H>=0, remain unproved here. No 4x4 SN>=3 witness, global Schmidt-number theorem, independent review or novelty clearance is claimed.
